title: PROPERTY & CONSTRUCTION ACCOUNTANT
summary: Property and construction accountant with 7 years of experience in property accounting, construction job cost and multi-entity month-end close for real estate owners and developers. Handles the books for a portfolio of 20+ residential and commercial properties plus related development activity, from AP and AR through reconciliations and ownership reporting. Works in QuickBooks, Yardi and AppFolio with advanced Excel. Independent, deadline-driven and used to being the single accounting resource across several entities.

roles.title: Property & Construction Accountant
roles.employer_type: Real estate and construction company, multi-entity
bullets: Handles day-to-day accounting for 20+ residential and commercial properties across six entities, plus related construction and development activity.
Maintains property and company general ledgers; records recurring and project-related transactions and intercompany entries.
Manages AP and AR: vendor and subcontractor invoices, tenant balances, payments and collections follow-up.
Completes bank and credit card reconciliations monthly; researches discrepancies and outstanding items.
Tracks construction job costs and codes invoices to project, property or account; prepares draw packages for lenders.
Prepares monthly property reports and supporting reconciliations for ownership review and supports year-end close with the outside CPA.

roles.title: Property Accountant
roles.employer_type: Property management company, residential and commercial portfolio
bullets: Maintained books across multiple entities for a portfolio of 40+ residential and commercial properties.
Processed AP and AR; reconciled bank, credit card, tenant and general ledger accounts.
Prepared monthly reconciliations and reporting schedules and assisted with close procedures.
Worked with property managers on tenant balances, rent activity, vendor charges and credits.

roles.title: Bookkeeper
bullets: Supported bookkeeping, AP, AR, bank and credit card reconciliations and general ledger maintenance.
Entered vendor invoices, customer receipts, payments and journal entries in QuickBooks.
Assisted with job-cost tracking and month-end preparation.
